cohort: 206,019 infants ≥37 weeks gestational age and ≤120 days of age discharged from Pediatrix Medical Group neonatal intensive care units from 1997 to 2010
finding: The incidence of late-onset BSI was 2.7/1000 admissions, with Gram-positive organisms being the most common pathogen, and late-onset BSI being an independent risk factor for death.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by Cesarean section had a decreased risk of late-onset BSI.
